The total number of students is 20. First, 20% enrolled in contemporary dance: 20% of 20 is 4 students. The remaining students are 20 - 4 = 16. Then, 25% of the remaining enrolled in jazz dance: 25% of 16 is 4 students. The rest, 20 - (4 + 4) = 12 students, enrolled in hip-hop. The percentage of students in hip-hop is (12 / 20) × 100% = 60%.

Answer: 60%
reasoning:
We are given: "In a dance class of 20 students, 20% enrolled in contemporary dance, 25% of the remaining enrolled in jazz dance, and the rest enrolled in hip-hop dance. What percentage of the entire students enrolled in hip-hop dance?" So total students = 20. First, 20% enrolled in contemporary. 20% of 20 = 4 students. So remaining = 20 - 4 = 16. Then, 25% of the remaining enrolled in jazz. 25% of 16 = 4 students. So jazz = 4. Then the rest enrolled in hip-hop: rest = 20 - (4+4) = 12. So hip-hop = 12. Percentage of entire students enrolled in hip-hop: (12/20)*100% = 60%. So answer is 60%.
